I ordered this Mobius camera to mount in my Jeep Wrangler as a dashcam and I'm pretty impressed with this thing so far. I've done a lot of digging in DashCamTalk and have seen the number one complaint about this camera is that it's confusing to setup and more difficult than others. That is definitely true. It isn't intuitive at all but through DCT I've found some software that is highly regarded and recommended by DCT users for setting up the Mobius and after getting through a steep learning curve I'm really liking this thing! I also ordered an Invisicord to make the setup even cleaner and am waiting on that to be delivered later this week.

This thing is TINY! It's probably 1/4 the size of my iPhone 5s and weighs next to nothing. I plan on installing a capacitor in place of the battery so I don't have to worry about an exploding battery when I leave it in my car all day in the sun. I'll probably be installing it on top of my rearview mirror via velcro but we'll see how that works out and move later if necessary.

Definitely recommend you guys check this camera out and poke around DashCamTalk to learn more
Got my Mobius camera from SpyTec the other day and I'm really impressed so far
